jumping cow.name: Jumping Cow
rules: Hunting is restricted to dove, turkey, doe pronghorn, antlerless elk, antlerless white-tailed deer, and antlerless mule deer.

Hunting and fishing access is allowed by permit only. Hunters and anglers must have a proper and valid license for their activity prior to applying for a permit. Permit holders shall have their permit on their person at all times while on the property. Permits may designate specific geographic hunting zones; in this case permits are restricted to the listed zone and are not valid property-wide. Access permits for hunters and anglers will be issued free of charge. Permits may be obtained via a drawing process. Applications are available from the CPW in Denver (303)291-7227. Application due dates are as follows: 1. Dove, fall turkey, doe pronghorn, antlerless elk, antlerless white-tailed deer, and antlerless mule deer applications due the 3rd Monday in August. 2. Spring turkey applications due 3rd Monday in March. 3. Fishing applications due 14 days prior to intended access date.
Permitted hunters and anglers may take one other person (an observer) who is not hunting or fishing with them onto the property; however that person must remain with the permit holder at all times.
Permitted hunters other than those hunting dove and wild turkey may not enter the property prior to the first Monday after the opening day of their individual season.

Vehicular access to the property is restricted. Motor vehicle use is only allowed on marked existing roadways that lead to marked parking areas. All other access is restricted to foot and horseback only.
All gates on the property shall be left in the condition in which they are found after passing through the gateway.

Access is permitted from two hours prior to sunrise to one hour after sunset. In the event that an animal has been harvested by a hunter, the hunter may remain as long as is reasonable to recover and remove the animal from the property.
Camping is prohibited.
Fires are prohibited.

stlGeneral: Public access is prohibited March 1 – August 31 unless otherwise posted (property-specific dates below override this).
Public access is prohibited from 1/2 hour after sunset to 1/2 hour before sunrise, except as posted.
Access is restricted to hunting and fishing. Everyone 16+ must hold a current hunting license or a valid fishing license.
Motorized vehicles only on designated roads. Access is by foot or horseback only unless posted.
Camping and fires are prohibited unless posted. Where camping is posted: no unattended camp over 48 hours, and no more than 14 days in any 45-day period.
No target practice or non-hunting shooting, no outfitting, and no non-wildlife public access. Pack out all trash.
Tracer, armor-piercing, explosive, .50 BMG rounds and fully automatic firearms are prohibited. Hay/straw/mulch must be certified weed-free.
swaGeneral: A valid hunting or fishing license OR a State Wildlife Area pass is required for everyone 16 or older.
Only properties listed in CPW's Chapter W-9 are open to public access, and each has its own restrictions (dates, weapons, vehicles, camping). Check this property's CPW page before you go.
